svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The X-band horn's 20 by 15 centimeter mouth at 10 GHz tiled in 33 square wavelengths, and the same tiles shaded by what each contributes: strong in the middle and weak at the side walls, with a clock hand on each tile turned by its phase lag, upright at the center and turned most at the corners. About 17 of the 33 squares' worth does the work
